Risk 5: the repo-wide grep above covers rake tasks, jobs, services, and scripts — no reference to from_omniauth exists outside the definition, the sole controller call site, and the two new spec files. The breaking signature change has no unconverted caller.

§4.5 factual chain, both ends traced at HEAD plus framework definitions: (1) middleware — omniauth is appended via Rails.application.config.middleware.use, after ActionDispatch::Session::CookieStore, whose prepare_session (actionpack-6.1.7.7 abstract_store.rb:70-71) installs an ActionDispatch::Request::Session at env['rack.session']; (2) write — the lambda's `env['rack.session'][:oauth_tracking] = tracking_params` goes through Request::Session#[]= (session.rb:131-134), which stringifies the key to "oauth_tracking"; tracking_params itself is built with string keys (iteration over %w[] literals) and Rack-parsed values (strings; utm_data a string-keyed Hash from the nested utm_data[<key>] form inputs — Hash responds to empty?, so the existing guard admits it); (3) read — the controller's `session.delete(:oauth_tracking)` goes through Request::Session#delete (session.rb:164-167), which stringifies to the same "oauth_tracking" and returns the deleted value — key/name agreement holds; (4) cookie round-trip — cookies_serializer.rb sets :json, so the hash re-enters as string keys at every level, including inside utm_data; (5) same-request in-memory flow — the @delegate Hash returns the identical string-keyed Ruby Hash object, so key types agree in both flows; (6) request_phase_params — omniauth-2.0.4 strategy.rb:238 stores `session['omniauth.params'] = request.GET` (Rack string keys) in the request phase and :270 restores `@env['omniauth.params'] = session.delete('omniauth.params') || {}` in the callback phase, so merged_tracking is a merge of two string-keyed plain Hashes with the session side winning — exactly the key type the new `merged_tracking['utm_source']`-style reads index. Absent tracking: delete returns nil, `|| {}` yields {}, all four reads yield nil, columns stay nil.

Diff-to-spec direction: the three focus files contain exactly 4 hunks total (omniauth.rb 1, user.rb 2, callbacks controller 1); each traces to §4.5, §4.6, §4.6, §4.7 respectively. No unspecced change exists in any of the three files. The two new SSO spec files in range trace to §9 items 2 and 3.
